caption: Ranked output from the Magis desk bots, one brief per desk per day, filed by pull request and checked by schema. A brief is research only: it carries no authority, sizes nothing, and never enters a base IRR. The one number on each row is the dashboard's or the filing's, not the bot's.

desks.author: claude-drew-special-situations

items.headline: MiniMed (MMED) exchange offer expired 2026-10-09 with the upper limit in effect; final ratio 4.5939 MMED per MDT; final-results 8-K not yet filed.

evidence.ref: 424B3 0001628280-26-064932 (7% discount, upper limit 4.5939, expires 2026-10-09, odd-lot priority)

items.next: Read the final-results 8-K (accepted and tendered MDT shares, proration factor, settlement date) and append a version-2 row to separation_registry.jsonl; then the unwind flow can be modelled.

items.headline: Capped ratio gave a 2.33% realized discount on 2026-10-09 closes (MDT 88.48 / MMED 19.71); odd-lot payoff $195.55 per 99 shares; no sleeve odd lot.
items.next: Nothing to tender; the offer has expired. Record the realized discount beside the filed proration factor once the 8-K prints, so the reference set gains a fifth data point.

items.headline: MiniMed (MMED, not in registry): modelled post-settlement selling 27.7% of float over 13.7 ADV days, 2026-10-09 to 2027-10-09 (estimate).

evidence.ref: SC TO-I 0001628280-26-061683 (225,361,295 MiniMed shares offered, 80.1% of outstanding)

items.next: Onboard MMED so the row can carry a registry ticker; rerun the flow model when the accepted share count is filed. A modelled flow is a timing input, not a value.

items.headline: Honeywell Aerospace spin-off: Form 10 on file (10-12B/A 2026-06-08); ratio, record and distribution dates not yet read; row stays in discovery.

evidence.ref: dashboard/data/separations.json row sep:hon-hona-2026 (gates.terms missing distribution_ratio, dates.distribution)

items.next: Read the Form 10 for the ratio, record and distribution dates, SpinCo debt and insider equity; the identity and terms gates can then rank it and the flow model can ask who must sell.

items.headline: FedEx Freight (FDXF) spin-off: Form 10 on file (10-12B/A 2026-04-10); terms not extracted; row held in discovery until the ratio and the dates are read.
items.next: Read the Form 10: distribution ratio, record and distribution dates, SpinCo debt, insider equity. Then ask who must sell.

items.headline: Corteva's Vylor (VYLR) spin-off: Form 10 amended 2026-09-21 (10-12B/A); distribution ratio and dates not yet read; row in discovery.
items.next: Read the Form 10: distribution ratio, record and distribution dates, SpinCo debt, insider equity. Then ask who must sell.

items.headline: Aptiv's Versigent spin-off: Form 10 amended 2026-03-06 (10-12B/A); no SpinCo ticker in the register yet; ratio and dates not yet read.
items.next: Read the Form 10 for the ratio and the dates, and record the SpinCo ticker when the listing notice names it.

desks.notes: Seed brief built by Claude for Drew on 2026-10-12 from the committed dashboard files only: no web, Drive or email reads this run, and the Greenblatt PDF was unread. Every figure is the dashboard's or the filing's; nothing was recomputed. Screens listed as empty come from separations.json (odd_lot_alerts is empty; counts.by_kind holds only split_off and spin_off) and the restructurings lane (post-reorganization warrants only, no rights offering).
